sim.containers.choose: Choose an action. Highlighted boxes are unsaved.
sim.containers.note.card: Everything, permanently: projects, presets, samples, settings.
sim.containers.note.project: 128 patterns, 16 songs, the pools, its settings. The active project is what the machine boots into.
sim.containers.note.pattern: Trigs, locks, length, tempo — and the presets of its twelve tracks.
sim.containers.note.preset: A track's parameter pages, setup and arp: the pattern's own copy of what was loaded.
sim.containers.note.pools: Samples and wavetables in RAM: 1023 and 127 slots; the samples may total 4 GB.
sim.containers.note.presetChanged: Changed: the pattern's copy of the preset, not the file on the card.
sim.containers.note.patternHolds: Holds the changed preset. Unsaved until the project is saved.
sim.containers.note.poolsNew: A new sample in RAM. Unsaved: the project remembers which slot only when it is saved.
sim.containers.note.patternRefs: References the new sample slot. Unsaved.
sim.containers.note.cardWritten: The project is written to the card: all its patterns, songs and pool references.
sim.containers.note.projectSaved: Saved. What you hear is what is on the card.
sim.containers.note.projectCarries: Carries unsaved pattern edits in its working state. Nothing lost yet; nothing on the card yet.
sim.containers.note.projectOther: Another project is active. Whatever the old one had not saved is gone.
sim.containers.note.cardOnlySaved: Only what was saved. The machine boots into the active project as last saved.
sim.containers.warn.memorise: Memorise is not a save: a restore point in temporary memory, lost when you load a project or power off.
sim.containers.warn.perform: PERFORM mode is not a save: leaving it reloads the pattern's last saved state, and its tweaks never reach the card.
sim.containers.rule.knob: manual §9 — a loaded preset is the pattern's copy; a knob edits that copy
sim.containers.rule.loadSample: manual §5.2.6 — samples go to the project's pool in RAM; the pattern references the slot
sim.containers.rule.saveProject: manual §9.1.1, §5.2.1 — the project, its patterns, songs and pools are written from the working state to the card
sim.containers.rule.switchPattern: manual §5.2.1 — unsaved pattern edits stay in the active project's working state until it is saved
sim.containers.rule.switchProject: manual §9.1.1 — loading a project replaces the active one; save first
sim.containers.rule.memorise: manual §10.10.6 — a restore point in temporary memory, lost with a project load or power off
sim.containers.rule.perform: manual §10.12 — tweaks live in temporary memory and are not saved
sim.containers.rule.powerOff: manual §3.2, §10.10.6 — unsaved work might be lost, and temporary memory goes with it; save first
keyColours.title: Key colours — Sixteen Tracks
keyColours.description: What each colour on the Tonverk's keys means, state by state, compiled from the sessions of Sixteen Tracks. OS {os}.
keyColours.ogDescription: Colour, blink and mode on every lit key of the Tonverk, and what each one means.
keyColours.lede: One key, several lives. What a lit key means depends on the mode the machine is in; this page lists every state the course meets, with the first step in each session where that colour appears on that key. The strips are schematics, drawn as the key looks: a blinking key blinks and a dim one is dim.
keyColours.seenIn: This colour on this key is first seen in: {list}. The course records a colour, not a mode, so rows that share a colour on a key share this line.
